item.content:encoded:
Mentoring comes to my mind, being mature means for me to be a wise mentor for the younger. I am grateful for the work of Jon Young and Bill Plotkin and their teachers, mentors and elders.

item.title: By: Brian
item.dc:creator: Brian
item.content:encoded:
I’m 47 and deeply grateful for this exercise. After an initial reading, I think this is a wonderful template for moving forward and plan to return to it many times. It’s helped me bring into focus my character flaws and my truest goals. Thank you so much for this gift.

item.title: By: Brian Donovan
item.dc:creator: Brian Donovan
item.description: This project is so important for anyone approaching ageing from almost any perspective. I am 69 years of age, and a retired academic (educationalist). I stumbled on a book on ageing when I was 60-61 years old, and, since then, have been reading/studying ageing, in addition to heath and dying. Sadly, it is next to impossible to engage people in their sixties, or older, to talk about either ageing, health or dying. Hmmm... I have order a set of cards from you on elderhood, and cannot wait to receive them. Greetings from the Irish midlands. Brian Donovan

item.title: By: Lisa Marshall
item.dc:creator: Lisa Marshall
item.description: I'm 77 and have been thinking about what constitutes "maturity" for at least half that time. (Pained by the reality that "mature" and "adult" are widely used as synonyms for pornography in modernity? I am!) So to see this is SUCH a breath of fresh air. The four holistic capabilities are exquisite. I'm working on having more of a sense of humor, and contemplating doing the exercises........ Thank you for doing this work!
item.content:encoded:
I’m 77 and have been thinking about what constitutes “maturity” for at least half that time. (Pained by the reality that “mature” and “adult” are widely used as synonyms for pornography in modernity? I am!) So to see this is SUCH a breath of fresh air. The four holistic capabilities are exquisite. I’m working on having more of a sense of humor, and contemplating doing the exercises…….. Thank you for doing this work!
